name: abzmyan
description: abzmyan (Agent Built, Zero Missteps, Yours to Approve, Next.) — a lightweight, index-driven spec-driven-development workflow for Claude Code. Five manually-triggered agents (Scribe, Architect, Builder, Archivist, Shipper) keep a maintained index of your project's architecture, domain model, and history as the single source of truth.
author: Andrew Malek
